meta.title: Codex Credit Hub
meta.description: Displays live Codex subscription rate limits and OpenAI / Codex API credit balances above the account avatar. Reuses Ego Lite when available, or opens a dedicated system Chrome / Edge login window once; subsequent OAuth refreshes run in the background. No API key input or storage. Includes Refresh and Sync OpenAI login actions plus codex_cli_quota and codex_api_quota agent tools.
